title: ID0467509-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002651] Check charging power
description:
Reported behavior/Issue: Check Charging Power
Solution: EV related issue

additional_info.subject: Description
additional_info.body:
Good morning,
we noted that the charger
170002651 during the last 2-3 days (from 12/12 up to now, 14/12) is charging with a power of 32 kwh instead of 250 kwh.
Could you please check this issue and let us know?
Thanks in advance.
Regards,
Manuela
software version
: v6.1.3-0-gfb2eb75

additional_info.subject: ID0467509-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002651] Check charging power CRM:03209000021
additional_info.body:
Good morning Manuela,
Thank you for providing the information needed.
Just to fully understand the issue. Was the battery of the car only able to charge a maximum of 32 kwh?
Or is the issue that the charger was only able to provide a maximum of 32 kwh in power, but did charge the car fully 100%, and took a longer time to achieve this?
With this information we are able to provide a solution.
Thank you.
Best regards,
Priscilla van Wettum

The charger loaded for 2 days with a max of 32 kwh instead of 250 kwh.
This is why we contacted you, to understand if an error occurred or what happened.
Thanks in advance,
Regards.

additional_info.subject: ID0467509-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002651] Check charging power CRM:03209000021
additional_info.body:
Hello Manuela, good afternoon. I hope you are doing well.
I checked the logs and found that the EV is the one limiting the session:
As you can see, the EVSE can provide a maximum power of 175 and current of 109 A but the EV is only requesting ~80-90A.
I will wait for your feedback before closing the ticket since it's not related to the charger.
Also from the session just before this one, it worked with much more power:
Thank you!
BEst regards,
Francisco
